Descriptions.Text: Slash. Physical damage uses the attacker's slash attack rate, the defender's slash defence bonus and slash absorption (armour, NpcParam, SpEffects), and the guard's slash guard bonus.
Strike (DAMAGE_PHYSICAL_BLUNT in HKS). Physical damage uses the attacker's strike attack rate, the defender's strike defence bonus and strike absorption, and the guard's strike guard bonus.
Pierce (DAMAGE_PHYSICAL_THRUST in HKS). Physical damage uses the attacker's pierce attack rate, the defender's pierce defence bonus and pierce absorption, and the guard's pierce guard bonus.
Standard (DAMAGE_PHYSICAL_NORMAL in HKS). Physical damage uses the attacker's neutral attack rate and the defender's neutral absorption. It gets no per-type defence or guard bonus.
AtkParam only: use the weapon's second physical attribute (EquipParamWeapon atkAttribute2).
AtkParam only: use the weapon's first physical attribute (EquipParamWeapon atkAttribute).

No physical type. On a bullet this means "don't override". On an attack, the physical damage gets no per-type modifiers and is not reduced by any physical absorption (armour, NpcParam or SpEffects). On a SpEffect it is the default and has no effect.
SpEffect only: the one value the weapon-buff override applies. Other SpEffect values are ignored. The buffed attacks then have no physical type, so physical absorption no longer reduces them.
